    def update_claw(self, dt):
        if self.cstate == "swing":
            self.phase += SWING_SPEED * dt
            self.claw_angle = MAX_ANGLE * math.sin(self.phase)
            self.rope_len = 60
        elif self.cstate == "extend":
            self.rope_len += EXTEND_SPEED * dt
            tip = self.tip()
            # bomb contact
            for o in self.objects:
                if o.alive and not o.caught and math.hypot(tip[0]-o.x, tip[1]-o.y) < o.r + 10:
                    if o.kind == "bomb":
                        self.explode(o)
                        self.cstate = "retract"
                        self.caught = None
                        return
                    o.caught = True
                    self.caught = o
                    self.cstate = "retract"
                    return
            if self.rope_len >= MAX_LEN or tip[0] < 10 or tip[0] > WIDTH-10 or tip[1] > HEIGHT-10:
                self.cstate = "retract"
        elif self.cstate == "retract":
            w = self.caught.weight if self.caught else 1.0
            speed = RETRACT_SPEED / (0.6 + 0.4 * w) if self.caught else RETRACT_SPEED * 1.4
            self.rope_len -= speed * dt
            if self.caught:
                tip = self.tip()
                self.caught.x, self.caught.y = tip
            if self.rope_len <= 60:
                self.collect()
                self.cstate = "swing"
                self.caught = None

            self.status = "over"

class Game:
    def __init__(self, root):

        root.bind('<Button-1>', lambda e: self.launch())
        root.bind('n', lambda e: self.advance())
        root.bind('r', lambda e: self.restart())

        self.time_limit = max(25.0, 60.0 - (self.level - 1) * 5)
